summary: V6.7 starts from the V6.6 terminal commit rather than reopening its radius recovery. ALSO, evidence-theory occupancy and SelfOcc motivate reusing the already-stored directional behind-hit ray state, intersected with same-Actor one-voxel support. The repair rule is frozen before the task-untouched cohort is scored.

The frozen head reaches 0.7105/0.7307 AUROC/AUPRC on 517 Actor-units and is above chance in all six scenes without refit. This is sufficient to freeze the matched 50% action set, but the globally consumed cohort still cannot support a fresh V6.7 claim.

V6.7 reuses the audited V6.6 package/action cores behind version-specific runners. The only pending P3 config field is the future P2 canonical run locator; no gate, budget or score changes depend on P2 output.

The package retains all 517 Actor states and complete metadata across 107 Actors with zero removal, zero hidden-target fields and no runtime model or hazard existence gate. P3 now binds only this canonical locator and keeps its fixed 50% budget unchanged.

The frozen 258-action L0 set handles 185 of 295 conflict states while retaining every Actor, hazard proxy and scene. P4 keeps these exact actions and adds only the pre-frozen source behind-hit requirement to one-voxel support.

P4 removes 67.90% of conflict points and preserves all Actor contracts, but overall/clean retention 0.3924/0.3965 misses the frozen 0.40 gates. The aggregated raw-endpoint behind-hit grid is not Actor/ray aligned after hit motion compensation. External ray-occupancy research motivates one target-frame analytic inward-ray recovery without changing radius, actions or gates.

The one structural recovery passes all nine gates: 51.74% conflict reduction with 53.19% clean retention and exact Actor contracts. V67-F01 is resolved. Because this cohort is globally consumed, the method now moves unchanged to the separate V65 P2 cohort for an end-to-end legacy confirmation.

The frozen head remains above deterministic chance in all six scenes and passes 4/4 gates on 570 Actor-units. q0 is about 0.03 stronger in both pooled ranking metrics, so no head-over-q0 generalization claim is made. The confirmation chain proceeds with the preregistered learned arm and reports q0/oracle comparators unchanged.

All 570 Actor states and complete metadata are retained across 119 Actors with zero removals and zero hidden-target fields. The fixed-action audit now binds the P5 and P6 canonical locators without changing the 50% budget.

The frozen L0 arm handles 191/312 conflicts at a 285/570 budget and passes all six gates. q0 is stronger pooled, while L0 exceeds 0.5 reduction in every scene. P8 keeps the preregistered L0 chain and applies the exact P4R physical rule once.

The exact inward-ray rule passes all nine gates on the second legacy cohort with 50.15% conflict reduction and 55.67% clean retention. The two-cohort legacy evidence is now positive. A preregistered unprocessed cohort from unused archive band 4 is required before a fresh empirical claim.
